lines.text: Hey Arthur! What kind of salary can I expect here?
Ah rookie... in corporate life, there are six types of salaries.
Number one: The Onion Salary. The moment you touch it, you start crying!
Number two: The Damned Salary. It doesn't help you, it makes you suffer... but you can't live without it!
Number three: The Agnostic Salary. You constantly doubt whether it actually exists.
Number four: The Magic Salary. Now you see it... and now you don't!
Number five: The Period Salary. Comes once a month... and lasts for four days!
And number six: The Impotent Salary. When you need it the most... it completely lets you down!
Wait... which one do we get?!
